newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk state sugar firm sees 97/8 output 1.58 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Turk state sugar firm sees 97/8 output 1.58 mln T.

text.p: Turkey's state sugar refineries company, Turkseker, expected to produce 1.577 million tonnes of sugar in 1997/98 crop year, up from 1.475 million in 1996/97, according to a government report obtained by Reuters on Friday.
The report said the company, which runs 25 refineries in Turkey, expected a beet output of 12.5 million tonnes in 1997/98, compared to 11.6 million tonnes this year.
It also suggested the beet area in 1997/98 would rise by 2.1 percent to 355,000 hectares from 347,620 ha achieved in 1996/97.
The figures did not include the output by three private refineries.
The report, prepared by a government agency which does not want to be identified, said Turkseker would have a revenue of 85.2 trillion lira in its 1997/98 sales.
The company plans to spend about 5.4 trillion lira for investments in 1997, it said. It did not give other details.
